boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free public art, campus space, library activities, and Scranton cultural events with no admission required.

cards.title: Browse Mahady Gallery
cards.subtitle: Shields Center for Visual Arts, Marywood University
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition hours, then take a slow lap through the displayed work and compare notes with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free public Marywood art-gallery stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists Mahady Gallery among its four galleries and states that its galleries are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check individual gallery hours; galleries close during university holidays, breaks, and between exhibitions.

cards.title: See the Suraci Gallery collection
cards.subtitle: Shields Center for Visual Arts, Marywood University
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit during posted hours and use the permanent collection as a starting point for an art-focused conversation.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to Marywood’s Suraci Gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood identifies Suraci Gallery as one of its galleries, says the permanent collection is housed there, and states the galleries are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check individual gallery hours; galleries close during university holidays, breaks, and between exhibitions.

cards.title: Drop into Kresge Gallery
cards.subtitle: Insalaco Center for Studio Arts, Marywood University
cards.notes: Look for the current Kresge exhibition before heading over, then spend time with one work each and swap observations.
cards.short_summary: A free public campus gallery visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood names Kresge Gallery among its four art galleries and states that all exhibitions, receptions, and accompanying events are free of charge and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the exhibition and gallery hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Maslow Study Gallery for Contemporary Art
cards.title: Explore the Maslow Study Gallery
cards.subtitle: Shields Center for Visual Arts, Marywood University
cards.notes: Visit during posted hours and pick a few contemporary works to discuss; the collection includes more than 500 pieces.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to contemporary art on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists the Maslow Study Gallery among its four galleries, states its galleries are free and open to the public, and describes the Maslow Collection as having more than 500 works.
cards.access_notes: Check individual gallery hours; galleries close during university holidays, breaks, and between exhibitions.

cards.title: Bring a book to Art Field
cards.subtitle: Southeast lawn, Marywood University
cards.notes: Meet on the southeast lawn for a read, a conversation, or a casual frisbee toss while staying within the open student space.
cards.short_summary: An open Marywood lawn for low-key leisure.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood calls Art Field an open space for students and specifically invites students to toss a frisbee or read a book there.
cards.access_notes: Open space for Marywood students; bring your own book or recreation gear if desired.

cards.entity_name: Forest Bathing: A Mindful Walk in the Woods
cards.title: Join the library’s forest-bathing walk
cards.subtitle: Scranton Public Library — August 14, 2026
cards.notes: Check the event listing and arrive ready for a guided mindful walk; confirm any registration or weather instructions before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A listed free Scranton Library activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Scranton Public Library’s July/August 2026 newsletter lists “Forest Bathing: A Mindful Walk in the Woods” for August 14 and identifies the newsletter’s events as free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 14, 2026 at 10:00 a.m.; check the library’s events page for any registration details.

cards.title: Catch the Friday Movie Matinee
cards.subtitle: Scranton Public Library — August 21, 2026
cards.notes: Verify the film and any seating details on the library calendar, then make an easy afternoon plan around the free screening.
cards.short_summary: A free listed library movie activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Scranton Public Library’s July/August 2026 newsletter lists a Friday Movie Matinee on August 21 and identifies the newsletter’s events as free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 21, 2026 at 2:00 p.m.; confirm the title and attendance details with the library.

cards.title: Team up for the puzzle competition
cards.subtitle: Scranton Public Library — August 29, 2026
cards.notes: Bring a small group, review any participation rules, and plan to arrive before the competition starts so your team can settle in.
cards.short_summary: A free, scheduled library group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Scranton Public Library’s July/August 2026 newsletter lists a 500 Piece Puzzle Competition on August 29 and identifies the newsletter’s events as free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 29, 2026 at 1:30 p.m.; confirm team size or registration requirements with the library.

cards.title: Walk First Friday Scranton
cards.subtitle: Downtown Scranton — first Friday of each month
cards.notes: Use the First Friday map to choose a few participating galleries or businesses, then build a short, walkable art-and-music route.
cards.short_summary: A monthly downtown art walk with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitNEPA describes First Friday Scranton as a monthly downtown art walk held on the first Friday and lists free admission.
cards.access_notes: Events generally begin at 5:00 p.m.; individual venues may open later, so consult the First Friday map and listings.

cards.entity_name: Nay Aug Park Summer Concert Series
cards.title: Listen at Nay Aug’s summer concert
cards.subtitle: Nay Aug Park, Scranton
cards.notes: Pick a listed concert date, check the weather and performer update, and meet by the stage past the pool area for an outdoor set.
cards.short_summary: Free public summer concerts in Nay Aug Park.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitNEPA lists the Nay Aug Park Summer Concert Series as free admission and says all concerts are free to the public.
cards.source_title: Nay Aug Park Summer Concert Series | VisitNEPA
cards.access_notes: Listed 2026 dates continue through September 6; concerts are weather permitting and performers may change.
